seed_and_query_overlap_clarification.known24_subset_origin: The 24 fixed known papers (known24) are the 24 core attack/defense seed subset of the 40 initial citation-tracing seeds (seed_n=24 in check_known24_offline.py), NOT an independent external holdout.
seed_and_query_overlap_clarification.why_35_of_60_not_returned_by_6_keyword_q: The two native arXiv queries required the exact hyphenated literal 'side-channel', omitting papers titled with 'fingerprinting', 'prompt leakage', 'keylogging', 'timing attacks', or 'metadata', and the 4 Semantic Scholar title/abstract queries used strict multi-clause conjunctions and did not index full texts of USENIX/NDSS PDFs. Hence the corpus is explicitly a seed-and-snowball anchored purposive collection rather than a keyword-query census.
